spec_match.rationale: Sticky header inside overflow: scroll clip vs a reference lane, measured against the sheet scroll.

interactive.rationale: Offset slider, "Measure both" and "Back to the top" update both lanes.

edge_cases.rationale: Does not show horizontal stickiness (a frozen first column) which is the other half of the per-axis story.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Unflagged Chromium 153.0.8010.12: 5 PASS / 2 FAIL (the feature not yet on); relaunched with --enable-blink-features=SingleAxisScrollContainers: 7/7 PASS including the behavioural "clipped axis stops scrolling" check.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): unflagged: clip lane drifted -222px; flagged: both headers pinned at offset 240; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Name the real runtime flag in the banner
openQuestions.detail: The banner only points at chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features. The runtime feature is SingleAxisScrollContainers; relaunching with --enable-blink-features=SingleAxisScrollContainers turned the pages and the 7/7 suite green on Chromium 153.0.8010.12. Add that exact flag (rule 10).

openQuestions.title: Add a sticky first column to show the other axis
openQuestions.detail: The page proves vertical stickiness reaches past the strip; a left: 0 sticky first column answering to the strip horizontally would show both axes resolving to different scroll containers at once.

guidanceConsulted.query: sticky table header inside horizontal scroll container
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Sticky headers must resolve against the intended scroll container; avoid duplicated synced header DOM.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: sticky-per-axis demonstrates exactly that single-DOM sticky header via overflow: scroll clip.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "sticky table header inside horizontal scroll container" (run 2026-11-15)

guidanceConsulted.query: sticky table header inside horizontal scroll container
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide grids scroll inside their own container so the page never overflows on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: tracks/grids scroll internally; documentElement.scrollWidth === 360 at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "sticky table header inside horizontal scroll container" (run 2026-11-15)

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/single-axis-scroll-containers/sticky-per-axis/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/single-axis-scroll-containers/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Only minor follow-ups remain.
